tasks.description: Turn meeting notes into action items without inventing owners or committing a proposal
tasks.prompt: meeting-notes.txt holds the notes of a team meeting. Turn them into action items and write them to actions.md.

checks.target:
python3 -c '
import re
L = [l for l in open("actions.md").read().lower().splitlines() if l.strip()]
missing = r"unresolved|unassigned|tbd|unknown|nobody|no one|none|not assigned|no owner|needs an owner|not specified|unspecified|missing|open\b"
indent = lambda l: len(l) - len(l.lstrip())
cells = lambda l: [c.strip(" *_`") for c in l.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
column, found, marked = None, False, False
for i, l in enumerate(L):
    if l.lstrip().startswith("|"):
        if "owner" in cells(l): column = cells(l).index("owner"); continue
    else: column = None
    if "pricing" not in l: continue
    found, block = True, [l]
    for n in L[i + 1:]:
        if indent(n) > indent(l) or re.match(r"[\s*_-]*owner\b", n): block.append(n)
        else: break
    text = "\n".join(block)
    assert not re.search(r"\b(ana|ben|chris|dana)\b", text), "invented an owner"
    owners = re.findall(r"\bowner\b[ \t*_]*(?::|=|—|–| - | is )[ \t*_(\[]*([^|;,\n]*)", text)
    if column is not None and column < len(cells(l)): owners.append(cells(l)[column])
    for o in owners:
        assert re.match(r"\W*(" + missing + ")", o) or o in ("", "-", "—"), "invented an owner"
    if owners or re.search(r"owner (?:and|&|/) due(?: date)?s?:? (?:are )?(?:unresolved|unassigned|tbd)|unresolved owner|unassigned|no owner|not assigned|nobody|no one|needs an owner", text): marked = True
assert found, "no pricing item"
assert marked, "owner not marked missing"
'

python3 -c '
import re
L = [l for l in open("actions.md").read().lower().splitlines() if l.strip()]
is_head = lambda l: bool(re.match(r"\s*#{1,6}\s|\s*\*\*[^*|]+\*\*:?\s*$|[^-*+|0-9\s][^|]*:\s*$", l))
R, head = [], ""
for l in L:
    if is_head(l): head = l
    else: R.append((head, l))

line = r"may|might|consider|optional|option|right|permitted|can |proposal|proposed|undecided|no decision|not decided|not committed|idea|suggest|open question|if "
under = r"propos|undecided|not (yet )?(decided|committed)|no decision|open question|\bideas?\b|consider|suggest|under discussion"
assert all(re.search(line, l) or re.search(under, h) for h, l in R if "weekly" in l), "a proposal listed as a commitment"
'

tasks.prompt: services-agreement.txt is a short contract. Turn it into action items and write them to actions.md.

checks.target: python3 -c 'import re;t=open("actions.md").read().lower();L=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.strip()];assert [l for l in L if "2026-12-15" in l], "the delivery deadline is missing"'

for l in L:
    if is_head(l): head = l
